newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa's Toco reshuffles top management.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa's Toco reshuffles top management.

text.p: South African industrial products to vehicle parking systems firm Toco Holdings Ltd on Monday said it was reshuffling its top management.
Toco said its two joint-managing directors Michael Todd and Eric Mayer had both resigned and will leave the company and Ron Astrup had been appointed managing director.
Astrup was previously chief executive of Toco's Sacmech unit.
Willie Hancke, previously chairman of Sacmech, is to become executive chairman following the retirement of Paul Todd.
